positions.position: Suggested online payments and booking advance.
Opposed payments on site due to complexity, preferring direct messaging.

conflicts.resolution: Online payments excluded from scope; direct WhatsApp messaging will be used instead.

dimensions.justification: Clear goals to attract tourists and measurable metrics (30 WhatsApp inquiries, 15 bookings in 30 days, Google Maps visibility).
Defines audience (Hyderabad/Bangalore tourists), device (mobile), and languages (English/Telugu).
Specific needs captured for Lakshmi (rooms, CMS), Ravi (menu, directions), and Meena (tours, safety).
Single-page structure confirmed with distinct sections for homestay, restaurant, and boat tours.
Functional features for business listings, direct WhatsApp messaging, directions, and simple content editing defined.
Detailed testable criteria provided for WhatsApp direct chat link, but other MUST requirements lack full Given/When/Then criteria.
Content ownership, raw asset submission timeline (end of week), breakdown by owner, and developer optimization duties specified.
Use of sunset photos mentioned, but visual style, color palette, reference sites, and logo availability are omitted.
Mobile-first focus, image optimization for web performance, and Google Maps SEO mentioned; browser support and accessibility missing.
$400 total budget, launch deadline before next month's season, hosting/domain allocation, credentials handover to Lakshmi, and payment exclusion defined.

out_of_scope: Online payment processing and advance booking system

acceptance_criteria: Given a user visits the website on mobile or desktop, when they click a business's WhatsApp button, then WhatsApp opens immediately pre-filled with a draft message addressed to that specific business's phone number.
requirements.description: Dedicated WhatsApp button for each business section to open direct chat pre-filled with a draft message.
requirements.title: Direct WhatsApp Messaging

requirements.description: One single page displaying section listings for Sea Breeze Homestay (rooms/rates), Ravi's Fish Kitchen (menu/hours), and Cove Boat Tours (schedules/pricing/safety).
requirements.title: Single-Page Business Listings

requirements.description: Written driving directions from the main highway and basic Google Maps indexing for directions to Velugu Cove.
requirements.title: Driving Directions & Google Maps Visibility

requirements.description: Website content available in English and Telugu for regional visitors.
requirements.title: Multilingual Support

requirements.description: Lightweight editing system (e.g., Google Sheet or markdown/CMS) for updating room rates and menu items without developer fees.
requirements.title: Non-Technical Content Editing
